The tumor demonstrates marked enhancement, necrosis, absence of T2‑FLAIR mismatch, and imaging features (midline crossing, ependymal invasion) that are atypical for oligodendroglioma. overall_comment: Imaging strongly favors an IDH‑wildtype glioblastoma (WHO grade 4) with non‑codeleted 1p/19q status. The absence of advanced sequences (DWI, perfusion, spectroscopy) limits molecular certainty, but the available features provide high confidence in this classification.
